name: Ask a question and predict (sky)
description: Student can pose a question about a pattern they noticed and make a prediction about what will happen, based on what they have seen.
exampleOfSuccess: After watching a sky object over a few lessons, the student asks if it will keep changing and predicts what it might look like next.
commonError: Student makes a statement instead of a question, or predicts with no link to what they observed.
checkpointTask: During any activity in this unit, note whether the student poses a pattern question and offers a prediction.
reviewNotes: Tether: AC9S2I01. Optional planning prompt. Scored A (met in any one unit = met overall). Phrased for any activity in the unit. NOTE: bundles the question and predict halves for simplicity; splittable if you want finer tracking.

name: Suggest and follow safe steps (sky)
description: Student can suggest a sensible or safe step for carrying out the activity, and follow the steps safely.
exampleOfSuccess: For watching the sun's position, the student suggests not looking straight at the sun and follows that rule.
commonError: Student rushes in with no plan, or ignores a safety point that was discussed.
checkpointTask: During any hands-on activity, note whether the student suggests a step or safe practice and follows the procedure.
reviewNotes: Tether: AC9S2I02. Optional. Scored A. 'Suggest a procedure' is rarely prompted by knowledge ICs, so this placement is what gives I02 its evidence.

name: Make and record observations (sky)
description: Student can make observations during the activity and record them using words, drawings or a simple table.
exampleOfSuccess: The student records what they saw of a sky object across lessons, using drawings or short notes.
commonError: Student observes but records nothing, or records something they did not actually observe.
checkpointTask: During any activity, note whether the student makes and records their own observations.
reviewNotes: Tether: AC9S2I03. Optional. Scored A. Already well-exercised by knowledge ICs; this makes the tether explicit. Any recording method counts.

name: Organise observations to show a pattern (sky)
description: Student can organise their observations to show a pattern, using a provided table, chart or simple model.
exampleOfSuccess: The student puts their sky observations in order to show how something changed over time.
commonError: Student lists observations randomly with no order or grouping, or sorts by an unrelated feature.
checkpointTask: Give a provided table or sorting frame. Note whether the student organises observations to show a pattern.
reviewNotes: Tether: AC9S2I04. Optional. Scored A. Partially orphaned skill; placement gives it a home. 'Provided table' holds it to the Year 2 standard (AS-08).

name: Compare with prediction and ask what's next (sky)
description: Student can compare what happened with what they predicted, or with what others found, and with guidance say whether it was fair or what they would ask next.
exampleOfSuccess: The student compares how the sky object actually changed with their prediction and says if they were right.
commonError: Student does not look back at their prediction, or compares without noticing differences in how things were tested.
checkpointTask: After any activity, note whether the student compares result to prediction or to others, with guidance.
reviewNotes: Tether: AC9S2I05. Optional. Scored A. Orphaned skill (no knowledge IC exercised it); this closes the gap. 'With guidance' matches AS-09.

name: Share findings using science words (sky)
description: Student can share what they observed or found, in words, drawings or a simple text, using everyday and science words.
exampleOfSuccess: The student tells or writes what they noticed about the sky, using words like observe, pattern and predict.
commonError: Student shares nothing, or describes without using any of the science words from the unit.
checkpointTask: At the end of any activity, note whether the student communicates their findings using some science vocabulary.
reviewNotes: Tether: AC9S2I06. Optional. Scored A. Fully orphaned skill (no knowledge IC asked a kid to communicate); this placement is its only evidence. Tune the vocabulary to your teaching.
